# Cell-Twin

Cell-Twin: A digital twin engine that creates virtual clones of patient cells using multi-omic data.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Patient-omic inputs initialize mechanistic pathway state; no validated patient-cell clone. Source disclaims personalized efficacy.

text: It runs "in silico" drug trials to predict responses, including apoptosis and proliferation rates.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Drug/combo ODE trajectories for viable/apoptotic/proliferating states exist; clinical response accuracy not independently established.

text: Cell-Twin enables personalized medicine by testing therapeutic combinations on digital surrogate cells, identifying the most effective treatments for individual patients.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Combination screen ranks model outputs, not most effective individual-patient treatment. No personalized therapeutic validity.
